column3: Kuroneko Route · Reversed Life Counseling
...Huh? Life Counseling? You want that? From me?
Exactly. It's fine once in a while, right?
Hmm...
Well, okay. Go on, I'll lend you an ear.
Kuroneko's been pretty cold recently. Kirino, could you do something?
W-Wh... Wha...
...The two of you are dating?!
W-We aren't--! What makes you think that?!
It's because of the misleading way you said it!!
...Huh?
Don't 'Huh?' me! I'm asking you when you started going out with her?!
What are you saying? There's no way I'm going out with Kuroneko.
Wha--!
Ouch!
Don't be so misleading, idiot!
Sorry. But listen, it's the truth that Kuroneko's been acting cold.
What do you mean?
She's been avoiding me. She didn't even accept the souvenirs I got from Kyoto, and she even turned me down when I offered to walk home together.
Gross! Is that what you've been doing at school?!
H-How is that gross?!
B-Because... getting souvenirs, going home together...
It's like you're h-hitting on her...
You've been playing too many galge!
However, she has a point there.
Gross...?
It's really gross, doing things like giving souvenirs and going home together...
What's that? Trying to trigger a flag?
I can understand that she'd fear for her own safety...
...S-So then, Kirino, the reason why I'm being avoided by Kuroneko is...
Don't tell me... since I was overly considerate about her... it creeped her out...?
Wrong.
Huh? But you just said...
That's definitely wrong. I was half-joking. It's true that you're gross, but she isn't creeped out by you.
...That's pretty confident of you to say.
Of course.
A-Anyway, I think there are other reasons why she's avoiding you.
What makes you say that?
Because it's the same with me.
Actually, the other day...
